items.title: the MODULE segments of a qualified pattern (`lib::deep::Mode::On =>`) and of a qualified struct initializer (`lib::deep::Overlay { .. }`) paint nothing - only the enum and variant (the type name) carry a token, where the same path in value position and in a type annotation paints Namespace since E315
items.body: The pattern arm of the analyzer's pattern resolution records only the variant (the last segment) and the enum before it (`analyzer.rs`, "Record each `::`-separated segment"); the struct initializer's path records its type name only. Record the module segments the way E315's drain does: a Type::Module row per segment. Pins: a three-segment pattern path, an initializer path, rename/find-references from a module segment.

items.title: a generic enum's payload variant in value position hovers without its payload - `Some` in `Some(1)` reads `Option<i32>::Some` where a pattern reads `Option<i32>::Some(i32)`
items.body: `variant_value_hover` (vilan-lsp) spells the declared payload only for an enum with no parameters; with E317 the instantiation is known for a constructor call's callee, so the payload can be substituted under the enum's arguments as `pattern_labels` does (`applied_substitution`). Pin: `Some(1)`, `Ok(1)`, `Err("no")` in a return, a binding and an argument.

items.title: E317's label scan (`Analyzer::variant_use_labels`) walks every `function_calls`, `expected_types` and `variables` entry per editor analysis for the ~20 rendered ids, about +0.5 % instructions per served keystroke - M148 (the hover rows rendered for every file) should fold it into the per-item rows instead of scanning the world
items.body: The scan is guarded by the reading aids (the CLI pays nothing) and by a cache-hot scope test before any map lookup, and it was cut to two passes; what remains is the iteration itself over std's share of the maps. Rendering the labels per item (the rows M148 plans) and restoring them with the module's record would make a keystroke in an unrelated module pay none of it. The same applies to E313's other row tables.
